AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Download only audited card/support images, deduplicate by hash, verify all files and generate URL index; rerun transfers zero unchanged files.

Verification.Command: Python updater integrity and no-op update checks

T-002.Title: Correct dealer sources, fallback and cold offline metadata

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Valid canonical IDs, safe country fallback, verified Used HTML source, bundled data shown immediately and retained when updates fail.
All three sections use bundled artwork first, official local thumbnail on failure and disk-cached network for unknown images, with unchanged layout.

T-004.Title: Native offline verification and durable reconciliation

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Cold native Mac and narrow iPhone show all three sections with outbound HTTP denied; screenshots/runtime checks saved and app remains open for user.

Verification.Command: Native offline entrypoint with failing HTTP transport, image/error inspection and screenshots; selected GRACE final gate
